|-|Walled City=
==Walled City ==
Walled City is the second World of Story Mode. This Map features a complex-looking path and introduces new Enemies with '''Buffs''', such as '''Cloner''', '''Shield''', and '''Regen'''.

'''TIP:''' Massive Titans show up in Act 4 onwards this map. They are the '''Cloner'''s, and they spawn weak Titans upon getting killed, that potentially had shields, fast speed, or regen, if ever the challenge warrants it.
<center>
{| class="article-table game-font-face"
|<b style="font-weight: 400;">Food:<b>|| {{Item|Mysterious Fluid}}
|}</center>

}}

|-|Snowy Town=
==Snowy Town==
Snowy Town is the third World of Story Mode. This Map has a short path and one curve around the center of the path. 

'''TIP:''' Clone Demons show up whenever. They are the '''Cloner'''s, and they spawn 2 closely stacked Clones upon death, making AoE units an advantage here.

|-|Fiend City=
==Fiend City==
Fiend City is the sixth World of Story Mode.

'''TIP:''' Aogiri Executives start showing up in Act 4, Wave 10. They tend to regenerate '''heavily''', and anyone who negates regen (such as [[Effects#Bleed|Bleed]] units, or [[Shigaruko (Symbol of Fear)|Shigaruko]]) will counter his regen.

|-|Spirit World=
==Spirit World==
Spirit World is the seventh World of Story Mode. This Map introduces '''Flying''' enemies.

'''TIP:''' Massive Hollows show up starting in Act 1 (as a boss), and Act 4 (as a regular unit). They are the '''Cloner'''s, and they spawn weak Hollows upon getting killed, that potentially had shields, fast speed, or regen, if ever the challenge warrants it.

{| class="article-table game-font-face"
|<b style="font-weight: 400;">Food:<b>|| {{Item|Soul Candy}}
|}</center>

|-|Ant Kingdom=
==Ant Kingdom==
Ant Kingdom is the eighth World of Story Mode.

'''TIP:''' Massive Ants show up at any act in this map. They drop an '''Ant Egg''' with 5 shield instances (it can stack up more buffs if challenge warrants it), which it's recommended if you take it down quickly before they spawn another unit. The worst case scenario if the egg spawns a '''Mutant Ant''' (2-barred HP, 5 shield instance), or '''Officer Ant''' (2-barred HP and fast) early in the game.
<center>
{| class="article-table game-font-face"
|<b style="font-weight: 400;">Food:<b>|{{Item|Cooked Fish}}
|}</center>
{{Story-MapBox|location=Ant Kingdom
|Act 1=The Officer Ant   
|Act 2=The Condor Ant
|Act 3=The Cheetah Ant
|Act 4=The Rage Ant
|Act 5=The Butterfly Ant
|Act 6=The Queen Ant

|Boss 2=Condor
|Boss 3=Cheetah
|Boss 4=Rage Ant
|Boss 5=Butterfly → Butterfly (Split) (10x)
|Boss 6=Queen Ant
}}

|-|Ruined City=
==Ruined City==
Ruined City is the fifteenth World of Story Mode.

'''TIP:''' Doubles show up starting at Act 4. They are the '''Cloner'''s, and they spawn 2 Double Clones upon getting killed.

If you go to the store to the left of the start of the NPC spawn and go through the door with the sign WELCOME, you can find a safe and a place to enter a code, by entering which you can enter a secret room with the YouTuber ToadBoiGaming, his friend and the capybara. Code: 412294

|<b style="font-weight: 400;">Food:<b>|| {{Item|Quirk Shard}}
|}</center>
